title: Verification assurance source
description: Verification-owned strategy definitions for the assurance table in the existing manifest. This source declares policy, never successful proof or waiver authority.

proof_profiles.description: Named proof profiles available to active planning assurance fields.

additionalProperties.description: Reusable command and review-aid set for a named proof profile.

required_commands.description: Commands that must pass for this proof profile. A command may occupy only one of the required, optional, or disallowed roles.

items.description: One entry in the required commands list.

optional_commands.description: Commands that are useful but not required for this proof profile. A command may occupy only one proof-command role.

items.description: One entry in the optional commands list.

review_aids.description: Manual review aids or checklists associated with this proof profile.

items.description: One entry in the review aids list.

disallowed_commands.description: Commands that this proof profile disallows for the matched assurance concern. A command may occupy only one proof-command role.

items.description: One entry in the disallowed commands list.

domain_proof_lanes.description: Host-declared proof lanes for domain-specific changed-path or task-marker matches.

additionalProperties.description: One host-defined domain proof lane. Domain meaning stays in repo-owned authority refs and evidence concepts.

purpose.description: Human-readable reason this domain lane exists.

applies_to_paths.description: Path globs that activate this lane when changed paths match.

applies_to_task_markers.description: Task-text markers that activate this lane.

commands.description: Commands expected for this lane when executable proof exists.

manual_evidence.description: Manual evidence labels expected before closeout.

review_aids.description: Manual review aids or checklists associated with this lane.

evidence_concepts.description: Core or declared host evidence concept ids used by this lane.

assurance_requirement_refs.description: Assurance requirement ids related to this lane.

proof_profiles.description: Proof profile ids related to this lane.

authority_refs.description: Repo-owned authority refs for interpreting the lane.

escalation.description: Conditions that should escalate proof or review.

escalation_conditions.description: Typed escalation condition ids evaluated mechanically, such as cross-owner, cross-claim-boundary, high-risk-requirement, focused-route-insufficient, explicit-request, or structured-override.

claim_boundary.description: Human-readable boundary for claims supported by this lane.

owner.description: Repo-local owner label for the lane.

route_role.description: Mechanical lane role for composition and overlap auditing, for example behavior, maintenance, evidence, or broad.

precedence.description: Repo-declared precedence label or rank used when overlapping proof lanes are intentionally composed.

allowed_composition.description: Route roles this lane is allowed to overlap or compose with without creating a contradictory ownership finding.

notes.description: Optional repo-local note about this lane.

requirements.description: Repo-declared assurance requirements that map work signals to authority refs, required evidence, proof profiles, review owners, and completion claim boundaries.

additionalProperties.description: One repo-defined assurance requirement. Domain meaning stays in repo-owned authority refs and free-form evidence labels.

level.description: Repo-interpreted assurance level for the matched requirement.

applies_to_paths.description: Path globs that activate this requirement when changed paths match.

applies_to_task_markers.description: Recognized former semantic scope. Markers never match raw task text as authority; exact facts or current agent applicability judgment resolve this scope.

applies_to_semantic_routes.description: Agent-selected semantic task-route selectors that provide applicability evidence without granting assurance authority.

applies_to_planning_refs.description: Planning refs or requirement ids that activate this requirement from active planning state.

applies_to_proof_profiles.description: Active planning proof profile ids that activate this requirement.

applies_to_risk_refs.description: Risk registry refs that activate this requirement from active planning state.

applies_to_invariant_refs.description: Invariant refs that activate this requirement from active planning state.

authority_refs.description: Repo-owned docs, policies, runbooks, registries, or decision records agents should consult.

required_evidence.description: Free-form repo vocabulary naming evidence expected before supported completion claims.

proof_profile.description: Optional assurance.proof_profiles id to add when this requirement is active.

review_owner.description: Repo-local owner label for review or waiver decisions.

force.description: How strongly this requirement affects guidance and closeout claim gates.

blocking_claims.description: Completion option ids blocked while required evidence for this requirement is missing.

notes.description: Optional repo-local note about this requirement.

requirement_class.description: Optional standing repo requirement class. Omit for legacy task-scoped assurance requirements.

source_intent_ref.description: Strongest current intent, requirement, or explicit repo-policy owner for this standing requirement.

source_intent_revision.description: Revision of the source intent or requirement used to derive this observable contract.

preference_target.description: Existing surface, skill, or operation target influenced by a guideline.

evidence_owner.description: Existing assurance, Verification, proof, or domain owner that produces the evidence.

detail_route.description: Bounded owner route for evidence detail or recovery.

measurement.description: Optional source-owned measurable condition evaluated against compact assurance evidence; the evidence producer cannot redefine this threshold.

evidence_label.description: Required-evidence label whose compact result satisfies this condition.

metric.description: Repo-owned identity of the quantity being measured.

unit.description: Unit shared by observations and the threshold.

comparator.description: Small supported comparison applied by AW to the observed or evaluated value.

threshold.description: Source-owned acceptance bound; evidence cannot redefine it.

tolerance.description: Explicit non-negative tolerance applied to the source-owned threshold.

aggregation.description: Maintained aggregation represented by the compact observation.

minimum_samples.description: Minimum sample count required before evidence may be current and sufficient.

subject.description: Measured subject or loaded fixture identity.

subject_revision.description: Revision of the measured subject or loaded fixture.

control_subject.description: Control or baseline subject for a relative/scaling condition.

control_revision.description: Revision of the relative/scaling control subject.

environment.description: Maintained runtime or benchmark environment identity; use none for deterministic checks.

source_revision.description: Revision of the evidence-producing fixture or measurement method.

producer_command.description: Exact bounded command selected by the ordinary proof path when current measurement evidence is absent or stale.

excluded_costs.description: Explicit costs excluded by the maintained measurement method.

requirement_refs.description: Repo-owned requirement refs normally applying to this subsystem.

claim_boundary.description: Human-readable boundary for claims supported by this subsystem profile.

subsystem_profiles.description: Subsystem-scoped assurance profiles keyed by existing .agentic-workspace/OWNERSHIP.toml subsystem ids.

additionalProperties.description: One host-owned assurance profile for an ownership subsystem.

assurance_level.description: Repo-interpreted assurance level for the matched subsystem.

scope_refs.description: Additional refs for the existing ownership subsystem that may activate this profile, such as ownership.subsystems.<id> or subsystem:<id>. The profile id must already be declared in .agentic-workspace/OWNERSHIP.toml [[subsystems]].

requirement_refs.description: Repo-owned requirement refs normally applying to this subsystem.

required_evidence.description: Free-form repo vocabulary naming evidence expected before supported subsystem claims.

proof_profile.description: Optional assurance.proof_profiles id to add when this subsystem profile is active.

review_owner.description: Repo-local owner label for review or waiver decisions.

force.description: How strongly this subsystem profile affects guidance and closeout claim gates.

blocked_without_evidence.description: Claim ids or labels blocked while required subsystem evidence is missing.

claim_boundary.description: Human-readable boundary for claims supported by this subsystem profile.

notes.description: Optional repo-local note about this subsystem profile.
